carla: FYI i kicked off the migration stress harness against the offload controller with soft-tether flags. initial numbers look okay but saw a tail of placeholder faults during a churn window.
nabil: can you paste the failing trace?
carla: pasted trace: ```
[trace] span=0x7f3a12, action=SOFT_EVICT, fault=placeholder, latency=12.3ms
[trace] span=0x7f3a34, action=MIGRATE_CANDIDATE, copy_bytes=3.4MB, pcie_ms=7.1
[trace] controller_override span=0x7f3a12 epoch=102 -> action=MIGRATE_CANDIDATE
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary: soft-tether-v0.1 -> 10% rollout in progress
carla: hypothesis: placeholder faults correlate with bursty dealloc+realloc patterns. suggestion: add short grace window where placeholder serves stale copy (read-only) before forcing migration.
nabil: +1. also, we should track placeholder_hit_ratio per tenant to spot noisy workloads.
carla: logging added and re-ran harness, will post updated numbers tomorrow.
